**Preferred term label**
hybrid osteochondral skeletal cell 

**Synonyms** (add reference(s), please)


**Definition** (free text, with reference(s), please. PubMed ID format is PMID:XXXXXX)

A skeletal cell at the periosteal surface of the murine rib that displays hybrid osteochondral properties, emerging within the large callus that bridges segmental rib defects. It derives from a Sox9-expressing periosteal skeletal stem/progenitor subpopulation that constitutes only a small fraction of uninjured rib periosteum. After injury, these cells populate the callus and co-express cartilage and bone regulators Sox9 and Runx2, as well as matrix genes Col2a1 and Col1a1, while exhibiting dual chondrocyte/osteoblast properties.

PMID: [30983567](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30983567/)
